scripts.setup: corepack pnpm install && uv sync --project services/api
scripts.dev:demo: corepack pnpm seed && corepack pnpm dev:clean-start
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm -r --if-present lint && uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api/lapsignal services/api/tests
scripts.test: node --test scripts/dev-services.test.mjs && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run --project services/api pytest
scripts.calibration:list: corepack pnpm --filter @lapsignal/collector exec tsx src/calibration-admin.ts list --data-dir ../../data
scripts.calibration:validate: corepack pnpm --filter @lapsignal/collector exec tsx src/calibration-admin.ts validate --data-dir ../../data
scripts.calibration:promote: corepack pnpm --filter @lapsignal/collector exec tsx src/calibration-admin.ts promote --data-dir ../../data
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
